title: SQL injection in PostgreSQL pg_dump allows an object creator to execute arbitrary SQL as the user restoring the dump,…
description: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in PostgreSQL's pg_dump utility that allows an object creator to execute arbitrary SQL commands as the user restoring the dump. This occurs when an inherited column has a child-local not-null constraint with a name requiring quoting. The issue affects PostgreSQL major version 18, specifically minor versions before 18.7. Versions prior to 18 are not affected.
